title: Structural Intelligence Compass: A 12-Point Research Compass for Structural Intelligence
description: The Structural Intelligence Compass is an open research framework for examining intelligence, computation, reasoning, organization, and their boundaries from twelve structural directions. Version 0.2.0 preserves the original 12-Point Compass as the research baseline while adding a Post-Release Structural Delta through the Additional Thoughts series. The new material develops Structural Differential Computation for personalized target discovery; Calling-Path Folding as a recurring computational pattern; Enumerative Structure as a computational possibility space; Local Learned Intelligence and Grounded Structural IR; Technology Convergence and Policy Surfaces; and a candidate synthesis direction toward Policy-Driven Structural Hybrid Intelligence. The release further distinguishes Problem Space from Intelligence Space, expands Per-Node Intelligence beyond single-model architectures, introduces Learn-on-Demand intelligence as a general organizational capability, and develops the progression from Structural Discovery to Structural Synthesis and Structural Evolution. Point 12 intentionally remains open: Policy-Driven Structural Hybrid Intelligence is presented as an emerging candidate interpretation rather than a final closed definition.
notes: Version 0.2.0 is a Post-Release Structural Delta. It does not replace or retroactively rewrite the original v0.1.0 12-Point Compass. Instead, it preserves the released Compass as a historical baseline and appends six Additional Thoughts documenting newly visible structural relationships, missing computational layers, technology convergence, Policy Surfaces, Per-Node Intelligence Spaces, and the emerging synthesis direction of Point 12. Point 12 remains intentionally open pending further structural analysis, implementation, and validation.
